content: Concrete crash lead from captain audit: ChatDetailScreen LazyColumn uses message.id as item key, while buildChatItems() sorts/filters but does not deduplicate IDs. Any transient duplicate in UI state creates Compose duplicate-key crashes and repeated rows even though Room is keyed. Please trace the state merge path and add a deterministic dedup policy/test at the correct boundary (not merely changing keys to indices). ChatTimelineModel.kt lines 18-65 is a likely defensive boundary; coordinate if ui-lead touches it.
